Capability.description: A measurable functionality that a Model can perform. Capabilities are the unit of certification in Athenas.

CapabilityLeader.description: The Model with the highest Certified score for a specific Capability on a specific hardware configuration. NEVER call this "best model".

related.Model: A specific Model holds the leader position

Certification.description: The process of evaluating a Model/Quant/Profile against a set of Capabilities and producing a Certification Decision (KEEP, ARCHIVE, REJECT). Certification is the core value of Athenas.

CertifiedDefault.description: The officially recommended Model/Quant/Profile combination for a given hardware configuration and use case. NEVER call this "recommended model".

related.Model: A Certified Default includes a Model

related.Profile: A Certified Default includes a Profile

Document.description: Any authored artifact in the Athenas system. Every Document has an ID, authority level, status, and explicit relationships to other Documents.

related.All types: Documents include all CONST, DIRECTIVE, REQ, SPEC, etc.

EngineeringLog.description: A daily record of engineering activity. Not a journal — a structured artifact containing: what was done, what was learned, what failed, and what comes next.

Evidence.description: A validated experimental result. Evidence is the atomic unit of proof in Athenas. Every claim must be supported by Evidence.
examples: BENCH-0007 (TTFT measurement for Qwen3.5 on RTX3050)

EvidencePackage.description: A collection of Evidence items that together support a certification decision. Not a single benchmark — an Evidence Package is a decision-ready artifact.

ExecutionUnit.description: An executable procedure. Replaces the ambiguous term "script". An ExecutionUnit has defined inputs, outputs, contracts, and error modes.

related.Tool: ExecutionUnits can be composed into Tools

KnowledgeGraph.description: The conceptual model that connects every entity in Athenas. The Knowledge Graph is not a database — it is the logical topology of all engineering knowledge in the project.

Model.description: A set of neural network weights, typically produced by training. A Model is immutable — it does not change after training.

related.Quant: A Model can be quantized into multiple Quants

related.Runtime: A Model is executed by a Runtime

related.Profile: A Profile defines how a Model is executed

Profile.description: An execution policy. A Profile specifies how a Model/Quant is executed on a Runtime. It is NOT the model itself — it is the policy that governs execution.

related.Runtime: A Profile is executed by a Runtime

related.Quant: A Profile uses a specific Quant

Quant.description: A specific compression implementation applied to a Model. A Quant is the combination of a Model + quantization algorithm + parameters.

related.Model: A Quant is derived from a Model

related.Profile: A Profile selects a specific Quant

Runtime.description: A software system capable of executing a Model (or Quant) on hardware. Runtimes are interchangeable — Athenas depends on the Runtime Interface, not any specific Runtime.

related.Profile: A Profile targets a specific Runtime
